title: Context space don finish
description: This chat dey reach the AI memory limit, like whiteboard wey don nearly full. We fit increase the memory window (wey dem dey call context size) make e remember more, but e fit use more of your computer memory. We fit also shorten the input, wey mean say e go forget some chat history to make space for new messages.

emptyReply: The model finish without reply. Try generate again, or check provider settings.
